req.title: Task description accepts long text
req.statement: The system shall accept task descriptions up to at least 1000 characters.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-032 states the system shall accept task descriptions up to at least 1000 characters. However, inspection of app/schemas.py reveals TaskBase.description has max_length=500, meaning the schema will reject descriptions longer than 500 characters with HTTP 422. The tests must probe: (1) a valid mid-range description (EP positive), (2) a description exceeding the schema max_length of 500 (NEG), (3) boundary at exactly 500 characters (BVA at schema limit), (4) boundary at 499 characters (BVA below limit), and (5) boundary at 501 characters (BVA above limit). This exposes the gap between the requirement (1000 chars) and the implementation (500 chars max_length). Tests are written to be mutation-resilient by asserting exact status codes and exact response field values.

tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_task_description_typical_long_text_accepted():
    desc = "A" * 300
    payload = {"title": "Long Desc Task", "description": desc, "completed": False}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["title"] == "Long Desc Task"
    assert body["description"] == desc
    assert len(body["description"]) == 300
    assert body["completed"] == False
    assert "id" in body
    assert body["id"] == 21
